criteria.requirement: The 64 saved BAR trajectories remain independent and retain exact save/restore data.
A trajectory on BAR 4 affects its first live pass without waiting for another loop.
Cold start waits no longer than 20 ms valid history, then reaches specified Wet within 8 ms after the fixed 1024-sample pipeline delay.
X rise/fall reads forward/reverse with scalar linear-reference error at most 2e-6 and no unsafe reads.
Stationary X uses a 20 ms grain with 2 ms seam; resume, folds, and jumps crossfade within 3 ms and remain finite.
UI Y top/center/bottom maps to +12/0/-12 semitones with stable-tone frequency error at most 1 percent.
Changing Y does not change X read position, direction, or BAR phase.
The complete processor pipeline has exactly 1024 samples latency independent of block size.
Depth zero and bypass equal bit-exact delayed Dry; preset-only equals legacy preset output delayed exactly 1024 samples.
XY-only, preset-only, combined, preset OFF plus XY, no trajectory, insufficient history, silence, bypass, and STOP are distinct; XY unavailability never disables preset.
Host Sync ON/OFF, tempo changes, 4/8 BAR loops and 64 BAR processing retain sample-accurate slot and control timing across variable blocks.
Seek and STOP/restart never replay stale XY audio; normal BAR and loop boundaries preserve valid live history.
Stereo relationship is preserved; output remains finite; 30 ms source silence fades XY to dry in 8 ms and same-BAR live resume works; correlated peaks are measured.
Audio processing performs no allocation, lock, ValueTree access, I/O, logging, or blocking and handles supported variable blocks using fixed memory.
XY DSP, scratch engine, Runtime Smoke, StateModel, aggregate validations and Windows VST3 CI pass on the same committed source HEAD.
Jev 1.13 individually passes all AC, Sol approves exact diff/evidence, and artifact/source/tree/AMD64 binary hashes match before candidate promotion; FL validation remains NOT TESTED.

supplementalReview.requirement: The baseline RED tests exercise the production live X hold and transition paths, with independent expected-value references and mutation probes that reliably fail when the Plan behavior is broken.

The reported AC evidence is tied to the exact source commit and Windows CI artifact, contains actual test exit codes and metrics, is bounded per AC, and contains no fabricated or cumulative-OR pass claims.
Production uses the approved velocity deadband, hysteresis, direction and sample-rate-independent timing, plus the specified true equal-power transition in the tested live path.
The live path remains fixed-capacity and allocation-free, transition re-entry is bounded, and worst-case retarget processing meets the tested real-time budget without adding output latency.

Promotion remains blocked for any required FAIL or UNKNOWN; the final audit requires exactly AC-01 through AC-16 once each and all PASS, same-source successful artifact, and a hash-bound Sol final approval.
